summaries.text: Process entry point that calls the CLI.
Unit tests for fetch helpers, including category, bill title, and PDF checks.
CLI for parsing bill PDFs. --fetch reads the Drive CSV cutoff and downloads only newer Verizon bills.
Uploads charges.csv to Google Drive by default, updating the existing file and keeping Drive-only rows.
Configures package logging and quiets pdfminer font warnings.
Tracks which PDFs were already parsed.
Parses bill PDFs and merges local charge rows with Drive rows so paid values and Drive-only rows stay.
Downloads newer Verizon bill PDFs. A View PDF that does not yield a file is skipped so earlier downloads are still returned.
CLI tool that downloads a Verizon bill PDF with Playwright and parses it into one aggregated CSV. Fetch opens Documents & Receipts, selects Monthly Bills, and clicks the latest bill title.
